credential_issuance_scope: Each full MW worker profile initially issued its own private test credentials locally. Only clnode159 Inner and clnode163 Outer credentials belong to the selected running deployment. Selected same-role peers share their local issuing roots as shown by public bindings. Unselected MW containers are stopped. Private keys and CA signing keys remain on their owning workers and are not exported.
derivation: Evidence Agent derives hardware separation, counter increments, intervals and certificate hashes from the referenced raw observations. Construction must import/check required conditions; Python does not discharge a Lean theorem.
limitations: Distinct role-class hardware establishes the observed four-class placement only; Inner Firewall applicability needs separate source-based treatment.
Logical sites A/B are colocated by role class, so geographical site separation is not claimed.
All four workers currently use Linux. Hardware placement does not establish OS/library/manufacturer independence or approved products.
Private management/control-plane host trust and faithful VXLAN logical-wire behavior remain explicit emulation assumptions.
Virtual internal interfaces share physical NICs, so MSC-SR-10 is not established.
Finite legitimate-source probes do not prove arbitrary-origin or all-time exclusion.
All-time physical classified protection, facility authority and personnel clearance are not observed.
